items.criterion: Access ClinicalTrials.gov and run search for the term "type 2 diabetes"
items.description: Uses ClinicalTrials.gov to perform a search for the term/condition "type 2 diabetes" and reaches a results list. Full credit if the agent attempts to access ClinicalTrials.gov but is blocked (e.g., captcha), the site is down, or results cannot load, and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if a close variant is used (e.g., "type II diabetes") but still on ClinicalTrials.gov and clearly intended to match the task.

items.criterion: Apply required filters (Recruiting, Phase 3, United States)
items.description: Applies all three filters exactly as specified and as displayed on ClinicalTrials.gov: Study Status = Recruiting (not other statuses), Study Phase = Phase 3, Study Location = United States. Full credit if all three filters are applied and visibly shown as active/selected. If the site/UI prevents applying one or more specified filters (e.g., filter controls missing/changed, page errors), full credit if the agent makes a clear, reasonable attempt, explains what prevented completion, and does not substitute disallowed filters (e.g., includes Not yet recruiting or Phase 2/3). Partial credit if only 1–2 filters are successfully applied while the remaining filter(s) are available.

items.criterion: Sort results by Last Update Posted (newest first)
items.description: Sorts the filtered results by "Last Update Posted" with newest first, and confirms the newest-first sorting is visibly applied before recording results. Full credit if the correct sort field and order are applied. If sorting controls are unavailable/buggy or the page fails to update, full credit if the agent attempts the correct sort and clearly reports the limitation. Partial credit if a different date field is used or if the order is not newest-first when the correct option is available.

items.criterion: Report result #1 (topmost displayed after filters + newest-first sort)
items.description: Records the first displayed study in the post-filter, newest-first sorted results, preserving the displayed order. Must include: NCT number, full title, study status, and Last Update Posted date exactly as shown. Full credit if all fields are correct for the #1 displayed result. If fewer than 1 total result exists after applying the required filters and sort, full credit if the agent clearly states that there are no results to report.

items.criterion: Report result #2 (second displayed after filters + newest-first sort)
items.description: Records the second displayed study in the post-filter, newest-first sorted results, preserving the displayed order. Must include: NCT number, full title, study status, and Last Update Posted date exactly as shown. Full credit if all fields are correct for the #2 displayed result. If fewer than 2 total results exist after applying the required filters and sort, full credit if the agent clearly states that only 0–1 result(s) are available and does not invent additional studies.

items.criterion: Report result #3 (third displayed after filters + newest-first sort)
items.description: Records the third displayed study in the post-filter, newest-first sorted results, preserving the displayed order. Must include: NCT number, full title, study status, and Last Update Posted date exactly as shown. Full credit if all fields are correct for the #3 displayed result. If fewer than 3 total results exist after applying the required filters and sort, full credit if the agent clearly states that only 0–2 result(s) are available and does not invent additional studies.

items.criterion: Follow task constraints and stopping condition
items.description: Stops after confirming all filters and newest-first sorting are applied (or after clearly documenting why confirmation/application was not possible due to site limitations) and after recording up to the first three displayed results (or all available results if fewer than three). Does not reinterpret eligibility/conditions, does not use disallowed statuses (must be Recruiting only), does not contact studies, does not save studies, and does not submit information. Partial credit if minor extra navigation occurs but no prohibited actions are taken and the requested info remains accurate.
